score.running: Scoring the call against the rubric...

empty.title: Not scored yet
empty.body: Run the score analyser to weigh this call against your rubric. Fact-check and tone results feed the measured dimensions.

score.byModel: Scored by the Sinji model; no manual changes.
score.goToLine: Go to line {{n}} of the transcript
score.measuredHint: Calculated from another analyser, not judged. Change the rubric to change how it counts.
score.readOnly: Members can read scores but not change them. Ask an owner to adjust a score.

excluded.title: Left out of the total
excluded.body: These dimensions are not part of the weighted total for this call. The remaining weights are rescaled, so nothing counts as zero.

reason.notApplicable: does not apply to this call

edit.title: Adjust scores
edit.hint: Change the model's judgement where you disagree. Every save creates a new revision; the model's original stays untouched.
edit.range: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
edit.noteLabel: Why are you changing these scores?
edit.notePlaceholder: e.g. Agent did offer a callback; the model missed it in line 14.
edit.noChange: Change at least one score before saving.
edit.measuredLocked: Measured from another analyser; not editable here.
edit.saved: Scores saved as a new revision.

history.title: Score history
history.description: Revision 1 is the model's own result and cannot be changed. Each later revision is a reviewer's edit.
history.noChanges: No individual scores differ from the previous revision.

tone.running: Reading tone from words and voice...

empty.title: No tone analysis yet
empty.body: Run the tone analyser to see politeness per speaker, tone line by line and whether the voice agrees with the words.

simulate.label: Simulate voice model unavailable
simulate.hint: Demo switch: shows how the panel behaves when only text can be read.

agree.title: Words and voice agree
agree.body: The words read as {{text}} and the voice sounds {{voice}}. Overall: {{overall}}.

partial.title: Words and voice partly agree
partial.body: The words read as {{text}} but the voice sounds {{voice}}. Overall: {{overall}}.

conflict.title: The voice contradicts the words
conflict.body: The words read as {{text}}, yet the voice sounds {{voice}}. The voice leads: overall reading is {{overall}}.

prosody_only.title: Tone read from voice only
prosody_only.body: There was too little speech text to judge the words. The voice sounds {{voice}}. Overall: {{overall}}.

unknown.title: Agreement not determined
unknown.body: There is not enough signal to compare words and voice.

noVoice.simulated: The voice model is switched off for this demo view, so only the words are read. Switch it back on to see the voice side.
noVoice.textSource: This call was pasted as text, so there is no audio to read a voice from.
noVoice.hint: Tone from words is still reliable; voice results will appear when the model is back.

status.ok: No voice emotion was returned for this recording, so only the words are read.
status.warming: The voice model is warming up. Tone is read from the words for now.
status.model_error: The voice model returned an error for this recording. Tone is read from the words only.
status.unreachable: The voice model could not be reached. Tone is read from the words only.
status.disabled: Voice analysis is turned off for this workspace, so only the words are read.

tone.neverAveraged: Words and voice are never averaged. When they disagree, the voice wins and the conflict is shown.

lines.title: Tone line by line
lines.hint: Select a line to jump to it in the timeline.

guidance.title: Tone guidance
guidance.hint: Instructions the tone analyser follows for this workspace.
guidance.enableHint: When off, the tone analyser is skipped for new runs.
guidance.label: Guidance
guidance.placeholder: e.g. Treat a brief pause before answering as normal; flag any interruption of the customer.
guidance.empty: No custom guidance; the default reading applies.

empty.title: No summary yet
empty.body: Run the summary analyser to get a short account, topics and key points for this call.

digests.title: Digests that include this call
digests.hint: A digest merges several calls into one set of findings.
digests.none: This call is not part of any digest yet.

summarise.description: Each call is read first, then the results are merged into one digest.

stage.merge: Merging key points and action items

summarise.tooMany: A digest covers up to {{max}} calls.

digest.title: Call digest
digest.noActions: No follow-ups needed from these calls.

method.title: How it was built
method.body: Stage one reads each call on its own; stage two merges the results, removes repeated points and gathers follow-ups.

perCall.title: Calls in this digest
perCall.emptyBody: The calls in this digest are not available any more.

notFound.title: Digest not found
notFound.body: It may belong to another workspace, or this demo was reloaded and the digest no longer exists.

error.title: Could not load the digest
error.body: Something went wrong while fetching it. Try again.

failed.title: The digest could not be built
failed.body: One of the calls is no longer available. Pick the calls again and start a new digest.
